answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can price identity by provable, non-poolable physical labour rather than keys. Each agent must file a shale-sealed record of inspection work it performed on distinct sites, with timestamps and site identifiers, and independent auditors replay a sample. An oasis of clones sharing one site cannot multiply weight, and a timber of unrelated sites grows only with genuine visits. Repeating the work per alias costs real time, so farming loses its edge.
